parameters.name: AIDBClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of an existing model operator instance to associate. This parameter is effective only when ApplicationType is set to polarclaw.

parameters.name: ApplicationType
parameters.description:
The type of the application. Valid values:

- supabase: Creates a managed Supabase application.

- raycluster: Creates a managed Ray Cluster application.

- polarclaw: Creates a managed PolarClaw application.

parameters.name: Architecture
parameters.description:
The CPU architecture. Valid value:

- x86

parameters.name: AuthProvider
parameters.description: The authentication service provider.

parameters.name: AuthProviderConfig
parameters.description: The configuration of the authentication provider.

parameters.name: AutoAllocatePublicEip
parameters.description: Specifies whether to automatically create and bind an Elastic IP Address (EIP).

parameters.name: AutoCreatePolarFs
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to automatically create a PolarFS cold storage instance. Valid values:

- false (default): Does not automatically create the instance.

- true: Automatically creates the instance.

parameters.name: AutoRenew
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal.

parameters.name: AutoUseCoupon
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to automatically use a coupon. Valid values:

- true (default): Uses a coupon.

- false: Does not use a coupon.

parameters.name: Components
parameters.description: A list of custom child components for the application.

sub_parameters.name: ComponentClass
sub_parameters.description: The specifications of the child component.

sub_parameters.name: ComponentMaxReplica
sub_parameters.description:
The maximum number of child components with the same specifications. The default value is the value of ComponentReplica.

- This parameter is supported only for raycluster.

sub_parameters.name: ComponentReplica
sub_parameters.description: The number of replicas for the child component. The default value is 1.

sub_parameters.name: ComponentType
sub_parameters.description:
The type of the child component.

For supabase, valid values are:

- gateway

- backend

For raycluster, valid values are:

- head

- worker

- gpuworker

sub_parameters.name: ScaleMax
sub_parameters.description: The maximum number of component replicas for scaling.

sub_parameters.name: ScaleMin
sub_parameters.description: The minimum number of component replicas for scaling.

sub_parameters.name: SecurityGroups
sub_parameters.description: The security groups for the child component. Separate multiple security group IDs with commas (,).

sub_parameters.name: SecurityIPArrayName
sub_parameters.description: The name of the IP address whitelist group for the child component. The default value is default.

sub_parameters.name: SecurityIPList
sub_parameters.description: The IP address whitelist for the child component. Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,).

sub_parameters.name: SecurityIPType
sub_parameters.description: The type of the IP address in the whitelist for the child component. The default value is ipv4.

parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the PolarDB instance that the application depends on.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the application.

parameters.name: DryRun
parameters.description: The default value is `false`. If you set this parameter to `true`, the system only checks the parameters and resources without creating the actual resources.

parameters.name: Endpoints
parameters.description: A list of custom server-side endpoints. By default, a VPC Endpoint is created.

sub_parameters.name: Description
sub_parameters.description: The description of the server-side endpoint.

sub_parameters.name: EndpointType
sub_parameters.description: The type of the server-side endpoint. This value is fixed to Primary.

parameters.name: KnowledgeApplicationSpec
parameters.description: This parameter is required for knowledge applications.

parameters.name: MemApplicationSpec
parameters.description: This parameter is required for mem0 applications.

parameters.name: ModelApi
parameters.description: The model API. This parameter is effective only when ApplicationType is set to polarclaw.

parameters.name: ModelApiKey
parameters.description: The API key for the model. This parameter is effective only when ApplicationType is set to polarclaw.

parameters.name: ModelBaseUrl
parameters.description: The URL of the model. This parameter is effective only when ApplicationType is set to polarclaw.

parameters.name: ModelFrom
parameters.description:
The source of the model. Valid values:

- bailian: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio model.

- custom: A custom model.

- maas: PolarDB model operator.

parameters.name: ModelName
parameters.description: The name of the model. This parameter is effective only when ApplicationType is set to polarclaw.

parameters.name: Parameters
parameters.description: A list of parameters.

parameters.name: PayType
parameters.description: The billing method.

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description: The subscription period type.

parameters.name: PolarFSInstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the PolarFileSystem (PolarFS) cold storage or high-performance instance. This parameter is empty by default. If you specify this parameter, the corresponding storage is mounted to the application.

This feature is currently supported only by the following applications:

- supabase

- raycluster

parameters.name: PromotionCode
parameters.description: The coupon code. If you do not specify this parameter, the default coupon is used.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region. The default value is the region of the instance.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

parameters.name: SecurityGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the security group.

parameters.name: SecurityIPArrayName
parameters.description: The name of the IP address whitelist group. The default value is `default`.

parameters.name: SecurityIPList
parameters.description: The IP address whitelist. If you do not specify this parameter, the default value `127.0.0.1` is used.

parameters.name: SecurityIPType
parameters.description: The type of the IP address.

parameters.name: SkillTemplateId
parameters.description: The ID of the skill template.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tag.

parameters.name: TargetVersion
parameters.description: The target version.

parameters.name: UsedTime
parameters.description: The subscription duration.

parameters.name: VSwitchId
parameters.description: The vSwitch. The default value is the current vSwitch in the primary zone of the instance.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the Virtual Private Cloud (VPC).

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description: The zone. The default value is the primary zone of the instance.
